items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, that's his wife, Helen Oakley.

ctx.x: Presently I have three or four publishers that want to publish the book, especially Stanley Dance. He's my dear friend. He's done a lot to help me out in everything. And so he's a dear, dear friend.
Yeah, that's his wife, Helen Oakley. Came over here from Great Britain. Stanley did, and I just love that man, I really do.
Well, I think to close out, I would like to ask you about the yacht caps and Atlantic City.
